name: Agentic Datasets
blurb: A machine-readable contract that lets datasets declare what agents can do, as 15 normative assertions with language-neutral conformance vectors.

name: Agentic Vision
blurb: Selective visual inference with observable decisions, replayed over 1,712 contiguous dashcam frames.

name: Agentic Qubit
blurb: A control plane that refuses quantum results it cannot certify, running entirely in the browser with no backend.

name: Semantic Field Canvas
blurb: A renderer for fields of nodes and links whose build fails if domain vocabulary appears anywhere in its source.

name: agentic-dataset-conformance
blurb: The contract as executable vectors, with a runner that needs no access to an implementation's internals. Apache-2.0 code, CC0 vectors.

name: authorized-recall
blurb: Retrieval quality measured over the subset a principal is permitted to use. Apache-2.0.

name: @agent-scope-ca/graph-canvas
blurb: The Semantic Field Canvas renderer as a React package. Apache-2.0.
